scope: Comparison40-v3 common fixed-repair behavior and v2 attempt-enter barrier, with spawn-service completion separated from first RUN step admission: Original three spawn_entity processes must actually exit0, followed by one successful same-world CLI entity_info(tb3) factory-cycle fence, before the sole coordinator can issue its first RUN physical token. Same original actions/namespace/SDF/arguments/spawn chain; no business/pose/observation readiness, no fixed sleep, no new ROS reader/executor. Same-session/profile administrative ready uses existing owned Unix ack socket. No synthetic clock/native progress or first-deadline reanchor; first begin_step uses original rule, subsequent absolute pace40/2wall RPC protection/startup180/stop remain. Explicit new complete cohort; old v1/v2 runs and diagnostics remain separate. This does not establish or eliminate the earlier Gazebo SIGSEGV root cause.

startup_contract.readiness: initialized gate received through original flow95; original readiness and no-motion safety only
startup_contract.first_slot: unchanged original allocation ATTEMPT, including awaiting observations or WAIT; no NN/candidate content admission
startup_contract.late_slot: record actual; timing failure; no backdate, catch-up or moving epoch
startup_contract.end: new decision and original send_goal entry permission [25,140); actual timestamps preserved, previously admitted inflight/feedback/cancel/stop ownership unchanged; not DDS send/acceptance timestamp

evaluation_stop: Original budget-only legal stop; quality-valid T95 is independent post-exit evaluation only.

nav2_goal_guard.reason: same2sim order as existing state freshness; stale map cannot trigger new invalidation and does not extend health guards

attempt_entry_barrier.release: same-session/profile/current-slot/actual-C-clock ACK before original decision_callback; not callback completion
attempt_entry_barrier.timeout: original 2wall progress limit, no added budget; missing first ACK is also bounded
attempt_entry_barrier.pacing: absolute40wall-ms deadlines unchanged; no reanchor/no hold-time subtraction; original qualifiers retained
attempt_entry_barrier.stop: authority-exited STOP_COUPLED/FAULT_STOP_OBSERVE bypasses allocation barrier for actual cleanup

startup_spawn_gate.ready: exact original tb1/tb2/tb3 spawn_entity action OnProcessExit, three unique actual PIDs and returncode0, then one same-world entity_info(tb3) query exit0 with genuine top-level Model.name=tb3
startup_spawn_gate.phase: RUN only before first physical token, including bootstrap tokens; original startup180 bounds waiting
startup_spawn_gate.timing: no token/no RPC deadline before ready; no synthetic native/clock; original first begin_step anchors deadline then absolute40wall-ms unchanged
startup_spawn_gate.stop: original authority-exited STOP_COUPLED/FAULT_STOP_OBSERVE may step for cleanup without claiming startup admission
startup_spawn_gate.interpretation: initialization/stepping separation only, not confirmed SIGSEGV repair; G0 paused-world factory feasibility requires actual startup validation
startup_spawn_gate.limitation: Spawn process exit0 only certifies model existence. The subsequent World request reply establishes a factory-cycle fence, not completion of all asynchronous sensors or a confirmed SIGSEGV repair. Exact CLI-native request send/response timestamps are unmeasured; recorded process admission/start/exit times are brackets. Model pose/velocity never enter readiness, RL or business data.
startup_spawn_gate.factory_cycle_fence: After three exit0, existing gz model -w effective_world.name -m tb3 -i requests entity_info synchronously on World.ProcessRequestMsgs. It brackets the completed factory Init/LoadPlugins cycle; CLI exit0 alone or Unable text cannot qualify. No fixed sleep/new ROS reader; original launch owns the query process.
